---
title: "Session 3 · Design: choosing the right study"
subtitle: "Week 3 · Saturday · 3 hours (15-minute break)"
---

## Agenda

- Recap quiz on Session 2 (10 min)
- 3.1  Study designs in pictures (45 min) + exercise "Name that design" (15 min)
- Break (15 min)
- 3.2  More designs: trial variants, pilots, quality improvement, qualitative (35 min)
- Exercise: choose the design for 5 questions (20 min)
- Proposal builder 3: design, setting and population (35 min) - wrap-up

## Timetable

| Start | Clock* | Min | Segment |
|:----|:----|---:|:------------------------------------------------------------|
| 0:00 | 08:00 | 10 | Recap quiz |
| 0:10 | 08:10 | 45 | **3.1 Study designs in pictures:** descriptive vs analytical, case report/series, cross-sectional, case-control, cohort, RCT, systematic review/meta-analysis, evidence pyramid, decision tree, strengths & weaknesses, what each design can claim |
| 0:55 | 08:55 | 15 | Exercise: Name that design |
| 1:10 | 09:10 | 15 | BREAK |
| 1:25 | 09:25 | 35 | **3.2 More designs:** trial variants (parallel, crossover, cluster, factorial; superiority vs non-inferiority), pilot/feasibility, before–after & interrupted time series (QI), qualitative designs; matching design to question |
| 2:00 | 10:00 | 20 | Exercise: choose the design for 5 questions (incl. your own) |
| 2:20 | 10:20 | 35 | **Proposal builder 3:** design + justification, setting, population (inclusion/exclusion) |
| 2:55 | 10:55 | 5 | Wrap-up |

\*Times are relative to the start of the session; the clock column shows an example 08:00–11:00 session. **[DS]** = course-dataset content (FLUID-ICU analysis and manuscript writing).

## Before this session

- Proposal Part 1 finished (question, background, five references, working title).
- The abstract of Paper 2 read.

## After this session (homework)

- **Group:** carry on with Proposal Part 2 — design and justification, setting, population.
- Think about which designs could answer your group's question and what each could claim.
